title: Klarna teams up with Alza.at, bringing flexible payments to Austrian shoppers | Klarna International
body_markdown:
Vienna, 2026 – Klarna, the global digital bank and flexible payments provider, today announced a partnership with Alza.at, Austria's online retailer, to bring flexible payments to hundreds of thousands of customers shopping on Alza.at or through the Alza app.


Alza.at shoppers can now enjoy more flexibility when shopping for the products they love, with Klarna payment options at checkout: pay in full, pay in 30 days, split a purchase into three interest-free installments, or financing.


"Alza is one of the most recognized names in Austria's online retail, and the place where hundreds of thousands of Austrians shop for their goods – from electronics and home appliances to private label products," said Florian Dutter, Country Lead for Austria at Klarna. "Whether a customer is checking out on Alza.at or tapping through the Alza app, they now have the power to choose the payment method that works best for them."


"Partnering with Klarna allows us to enhance the shopping experience with more payment flexibility at checkout, supporting a seamless journey that gives customers more control over how they shop. The expansion of payment options is actively shaping the online retail market. At Alza, Klarna is used across a wide range of purchases, with mobile phones, gaming devices and household appliances among the most popular. That said, Klarna can of course be applied to any purchase," said Lukáš Mikolášek, Managing Director of Alza.at GmbH.


The partnership reflects Klarna's continued growth across Austria, with more than one million retailers globally trusting Klarna to drive growth and customer loyalty.
